title: Down by the River
notes: Flushed-out Mojo Dojo content topic. Unit 1168 — 2022 Ford Transit 350 HD AWD cutaway → Embassy Specialty Vehicles Fortress mobile-showroom body → owner-finished interior. Dual deliverables: public build showcase + private owner's dashboard (Victron VRM, climate, cameras). Drive folder "Down by the River" is the durable SoT for specs, copy, and handoffs; Mbot Stage exports track Session 2 confirm/defer work. Mojo shoots shop/van work; Ink cuts and publishes to @Mojowerkin.
ideas: Series framing: luxury-RV convenience assembled à la carte — Victron whole-home power for ~$4k parts, T-slot + plywood galley, 3D-printed problem-solvers
Episode: chassis & Embassy body — Transit 350 HD AWD cutaway story, Unit 1168 delivery, Fortress composite shell
Episode: Victron power stack — NAZ order walkthrough, Cerbo GX, MultiPlus, battery, solar (observe-only; no live VRM control on camera without scrubbing credentials)
Episode: Galley build — farmhouse sink, touchless faucet, Bodega fridge, Cosori, SEAFLO pump; plumbing bay B-roll before drawers closed
Episode: Cabinets & finish — 80/20 extrusion, Patriot Timber ply, Osmo Polyx-Oil as hardwax oil (not polyurethane)
Episode: Climate stack — Shinic + Inkbird for cold floor; Midea Duo heat pump ~41°F outdoor limit (complementary, not redundant)
Episode: Printed parts — heater cap deflector, IKEA desk brackets, switch-plate faceplate (STL renders + install)
Episode / short: Never-publish scrub — Cerbo WiFi/BT pin photo, full VIN, home address, VRM portal ID, Embassy CAD IP
Future series hook: private dashboard build (VRM embed → RuuviTag → HVAC → camera) as Mojo Dojo tech-in-the-shop content
Shot list wishlist: Nov plumbing photos, electrical bay, cabinet grain close-ups, exterior hero (pole barn is NOT the hero), river/shop context B-roll
